author: Wahiz
body: Ok, so I have gone over the new rules and what will happening. But I know im the last player you guys want on your server but I really want to have a second chance.. I was wondering from now on starting at Oct 28,2015 at 7:45pm (AST My TimeZone) if im clean and dont ban evade etc... next year on December/January and I appeal to the best of my ability would you consider giving me a second channce??? Please :(......

title: Appeal Question (Sr Mods Only Reply)

replies.author: MidnightBeats
replies.body: Ban evasion is a non-negotiable punishment once it has been done, making appeals for ban evasion impossible. Unless you can prove you were not ban evading, you will most likely not be appealed.

replies.author: gobernment
replies.body: Not really. Regardless of the policy, the evasions in general were beyond excessive, and caused the staff a lot of trouble to actually enforce the punishment. You broke the rules a lot, and I don't think it should necessarily be rewarded by unbanning you.
